mappings.rationale: The safeguard explicitly requires the deployment of a network intrusion detection solution (NIDS), which is a direct implementation of the target IDS/IPS.
The safeguard explicitly requires the deployment of a host-based intrusion detection solution, which is a direct implementation of the target IDS/IPS.
Anti-exploitation features provide preventative protection against the types of attacks that IDS/IPS are designed to detect, but they are distinct technical controls.
Role-specific security training is a general administrative control and does not directly implement or relate to the technical deployment of IDS/IPS.
